svg.aria-label: One wave of 32 threads decodes one 256-value PFOR block. Thread t starts at value 8t and bit offset t times b. In list mode threads t0 to t5 each hold one exception position, and a wave OR drops them all into one 256-bit mask that every thread holds. Each thread counts the mask bits before 8t to get its rank, and the threads that own exceptions read their high bits at rank times eb. In bitmap mode t0 to t7 broadcast one 32-bit word each to build the same mask.

g.text: thread t starts at value 8t, bit t × b, and nobody waits
in list mode a wave OR folds the positions into one mask
rank = mask bits before 8t, a popcount
owners read their high bits at rank × eb

svg.text: one wave, one block, and positions, mask and ranks stay in registers
256 bits, the same in every thread, built without memory
bitmap mode builds the same mask when t0 to t7 each load one 32-bit word and broadcast it
